# Options: REST API Reference

19 REST endpoints. Start with [README.md](README.md) for this class's rules and gotchas.

Legend: `\*` = required parameter; `(.gt .gte …)` = comparison variants of that parameter
(e.g. `ticker.any_of=AAPL,MSFT`, `date.gte=2025-01-01`). **Plan** = cheapest individual plan that
includes the endpoint (`+`), then data recency and history depth per plan. Plan gates change: if a
call 403s on a listed plan, re-fetch the endpoint's doc page. Auth, envelope, and pagination rules:
[../foundations/README.md](../foundations/README.md).

## Aggregates

### Custom Bars (OHLC)

`GET /v2/aggs/ticker/{optionsTicker}/range/{multiplier}/{timespan}/{from}/{to}` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/options/aggregates/custom-bars.md)

Retrieve aggregated historical OHLC (Open, High, Low, Close) and volume data for a specified options contract over a custom date range and time interval in Eastern Time (ET).

- **Params:** `optionsTicker`\*, `multiplier`\*, `timespan`\*, `from`\*, `to`\*, `adjusted`, `sort`, `limit`
- **Returns:** `ticker adjusted queryCount resultsCount` · results[]: `c h l n o t v vw`
- **Plan:** all individual plans · recency Basic EOD · Starter–Developer 15-min delayed · Advanced Real-time · history Basic–Starter 2y · Developer 4y · Advanced all

### Daily Ticker Summary (OHLC)

`GET /v1/open-close/{optionsTicker}/{date}` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/options/aggregates/daily-ticker-summary.md)

Retrieve the opening and closing prices for a specific options contract on a given date, along with any pre-market and after-hours trade prices.

- **Params:** `optionsTicker`\*, `date`\*, `adjusted`
- **Returns:** `afterHours close from high low open otc preMarket symbol volume`
- **Plan:** all individual plans · recency Basic EOD · Starter–Developer 15-min delayed · Advanced Real-time · history Basic–Starter 2y · Developer 4y · Advanced all

### Previous Day Bar (OHLC)

`GET /v2/aggs/ticker/{optionsTicker}/prev` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/options/aggregates/previous-day-bar.md)

Retrieve the previous trading day's open, high, low, and close (OHLC) data for a specified option contract.

- **Params:** `optionsTicker`\*, `adjusted`
- **Returns:** `ticker adjusted queryCount resultsCount` · results[]: `T c h l n o t v vw`
- **Plan:** all individual plans · recency Basic EOD · Starter–Developer 15-min delayed · Advanced Real-time

## Contracts

### All Contracts

`GET /v3/reference/options/contracts` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/options/contracts/all-contracts.md)

Retrieve a comprehensive index of options contracts, encompassing both active and expired listings.

- **Params:** `underlying_ticker` (.gte .gt .lte .lt), `ticker`, `contract_type`, `expiration_date` (.gte .gt .lte .lt), `as_of`, `strike_price` (.gte .gt .lte .lt), `expired`, `order`, `limit`, `sort`
- **Returns:** results[]: `additional_underlyings cfi contract_type correction exercise_style expiration_date primary_exchange shares_per_contract strike_price ticker underlying_ticker` · paginates via `next_url`
- **Plan:** all individual plans · recency Basic–Advanced Updated daily · history Basic 2y · Starter–Advanced all

### Contract Overview

`GET /v3/reference/options/contracts/{options_ticker}` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/options/contracts/contract-overview.md)

Retrieve detailed information about a specific options contract, including its contract type (call or put), exercise style, expiration date, strike price, shares per contract, underlying ticker, and primary exchange.

- **Params:** `options_ticker`\*, `as_of`
- **Returns:** results: `additional_underlyings cfi contract_type correction exercise_style expiration_date primary_exchange shares_per_contract strike_price ticker underlying_ticker`
- **Plan:** all individual plans · recency Basic–Advanced Updated daily · history Basic 2y · Starter–Advanced all

## Market Operations

### Condition Codes

`GET /v3/reference/conditions` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/options/market-operations/condition-codes.md)

Retrieve a unified and comprehensive list of trade and quote conditions from various upstream market data providers (e.g., CTA, UTP, OPRA, FINRA).

- **Params:** `asset_class`, `data_type`, `id`, `sip`, `order`, `limit`, `sort`
- **Returns:** results[]: `abbreviation asset_class data_types description exchange id legacy name sip_mapping type update_rules` · paginates via `next_url`
- **Plan:** all individual plans · recency Basic–Advanced Updated as needed

### Exchanges

`GET /v3/reference/exchanges` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/options/market-operations/exchanges.md)

Retrieve a list of known exchanges, including their identifiers, names, market types, and other relevant attributes.

- **Params:** `asset_class`, `locale`
- **Returns:** results[]: `acronym asset_class id locale mic name operating_mic participant_id type url`
- **Plan:** all individual plans · recency Basic–Advanced Updated as needed

### Market Holidays

`GET /v1/marketstatus/upcoming` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/options/market-operations/market-holidays.md)

Retrieve upcoming market holidays and their corresponding open/close times.

- **Plan:** all individual plans · recency Basic–Advanced Updated as needed

### Market Status

`GET /v1/marketstatus/now` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/options/market-operations/market-status.md)

Retrieve the current trading status for various exchanges and overall financial markets.

- **Returns:** `afterHours currencies earlyHours exchanges indicesGroups market serverTime` · currencies: `crypto fx` · exchanges: `nasdaq nyse otc` · indicesGroups: `cccy cgi dow_jones ftse_russell msci mstar mstarc nasdaq s_and_p societe_generale`
- **Plan:** all individual plans · recency Basic–Advanced Updated in real time

## Snapshots

### Option Chain Snapshot

`GET /v3/snapshot/options/{underlyingAsset}` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/options/snapshots/option-chain-snapshot.md)

Retrieve a comprehensive snapshot of all options contracts associated with a specified underlying ticker.

- **Params:** `underlyingAsset`\*, `strike_price` (.gte .gt .lte .lt), `expiration_date` (.gte .gt .lte .lt), `contract_type`, `order`, `limit`, `sort`
- **Returns:** results[]: `break_even_price day details fmv fmv_last_updated greeks implied_volatility last_quote last_trade open_interest underlying_asset` · paginates via `next_url`
- **Plan:** Starter+ · recency Starter–Developer 15-min delayed · Advanced Real-time

### Option Contract Snapshot

`GET /v3/snapshot/options/{underlyingAsset}/{optionContract}` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/options/snapshots/option-contract-snapshot.md)

Retrieve a comprehensive snapshot of a specified options contract, consolidating vital metrics and market data into a single response.

- **Params:** `underlyingAsset`\*, `optionContract`\*
- **Returns:** results: `break_even_price day details fmv fmv_last_updated greeks implied_volatility last_quote last_trade open_interest underlying_asset` · paginates via `next_url`
- **Plan:** Starter+ · recency Starter–Developer 15-min delayed · Advanced Real-time

### Unified Snapshot

`GET /v3/snapshot` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/options/snapshots/unified-snapshot.md)

Retrieve unified snapshots of market data for multiple asset classes including stocks, options, forex, and cryptocurrencies in a single request.

- **Params:** `ticker` (.gte .gt .lte .lt .any_of), `type`, `order`, `limit`, `sort`
- **Returns:** results[]: `break_even_price details error fmv fmv_last_updated greeks implied_volatility last_quote last_trade market_status message name open_interest session ticker type underlying_asset` · paginates via `next_url`
- **Plan:** Starter+ · recency Starter–Developer 15-min delayed · Advanced Real-time

## Trades & Quotes

### Last Trade

`GET /v2/last/trade/{optionsTicker}` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/options/trades-quotes/last-trade.md)

Retrieve the latest available trade for a specified options contact, including details such as price, size, exchange, and timestamp.

- **Params:** `optionsTicker`\*
- **Returns:** results: `T c e f i p q r s t x y z`
- **Plan:** Developer+ · recency Developer 15-min delayed · Advanced Real-time

### Quotes

`GET /v3/quotes/{optionsTicker}` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/options/trades-quotes/quotes.md)

Retrieve historical quotes for a specified options contract over a defined time range.

- **Params:** `optionsTicker`\*, `timestamp` (.gte .gt .lte .lt), `order`, `limit`, `sort`
- **Returns:** results[]: `ask_exchange ask_price ask_size bid_exchange bid_price bid_size sequence_number sip_timestamp` · paginates via `next_url`
- **Plan:** Advanced+ · recency Advanced Real-time · history Advanced all

### Trades

`GET /v3/trades/{optionsTicker}` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/rest/options/trades-quotes/trades.md)

Retrieve comprehensive, tick-level trade data for a specified options ticker within a defined time range.

- **Params:** `optionsTicker`\*, `timestamp` (.gte .gt .lte .lt), `order`, `limit`, `sort`
- **Returns:** results[]: `conditions correction exchange id participant_timestamp price sequence_number sip_timestamp size` · paginates via `next_url`
- **Plan:** Developer+ · recency Developer 15-min delayed · Advanced Real-time · history Developer 4y · Advanced all
